text:
Namaste! Office bonus milne ki badhaai ho! Aap apne loan account ko pre-close karna chahte hain, yeh bahut accha decision hai.

Lekin, mere paas jo tools available hain, unse main currently EMI status check kar sakta hoon aur monthly due date (new due day) reschedule kar sakta hoon. Main loan prepayment, outstanding amount calculate karne, ya loan department mein call transfer karne ke liye directly actions nahi le sakta.

Main aapko loan department ke human agent ke paas transfer kar deta hoon taaki woh aapko exact outstanding amount, prepayment charges, aur full closure ki poori process bata sakein. 

Kya main aapko abhi loan department transfer karoon?
